x: There were so many good performances that they all really deserve a mention but in particular it was good to see Simon Alexander win the colts' 1500 metres and Gavin Mason run a superb race to win the boys' 800 metres.

Tom Evans and Simon Alexander had great runs at Lloyd Park - they surprised some of the Youths and pushed them out of the scoring five! Unfortunately we will be in Division Two with the Seniors next year.
In the Junior Boys age group Simon Alexander was 241st for Surrey and Gavin Jones 243rd for Sussex. We believe Simon Vella ran for London but can't find his name among the results.
Our Under 15 Boys had started the medal spree by gaining an unexpected second team place, both Simon Alexander and James Drake running very confidently.
He stormed through the field to set our fastest time and with Simon Alexander on the final lap running a good anchor leg the Bels had a completely unexpected 5th place.
John Wilson and Simon Alexander both scored well for us in the McDonald's League distance races; on this occasion, at Deangate, they both went well under 10 minutes for the 3,000 metres..
Gavin Jones was the man attempting to break away early in the lap but as the runners came out of the woods and into the finishing straight it was Simon Alexander who had got ahead.

John Wilson and Simon Alexander ran strongly in the U17 3k and Simon Vella had no problems in the U15 1500m. In fact, in the upper age-group we were as strong as any team but our younger lads were giving away years, many of them being eligible for the same age group for a good while to come yet and…

Simon Alexander was 2nd under 16 in the 2.75k Croydon Advertiser schools race at Lloyd Park on March 5th in 16:17. Meanwhile, up at Sefton Park, Liverpool, the English Schools CC Champs. were taking place with six Belgravians taking part.
